description: This file defines the class MappedOutboundSignal, which represents an outbound signal mapped to an external message within the Eclipse Ditto project. It wraps an existing OutboundSignal, along with an Adaptable and ExternalMessage, providing methods to access these components and serialize the object to JSON.

classes.name: MappedOutboundSignal
classes.description: A final class representing a mapped outbound signal, wrapping an OutboundSignal, an Adaptable, and an ExternalMessage, with methods for access and JSON conversion.

methods.name: getExternalMessage
methods.description: Returns the external message associated with this mapped outbound signal.

methods.name: getAdaptable
methods.description: Returns the adaptable component of this signal.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the source signal that this mapped signal wraps.

methods.name: getTargets
methods.description: Returns the list of targets for this signal.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the mapped outbound signal to a JsonObject, omitting the external message.
